feedBatchBlocked: {project}: {label} passed its checks, and {place} holds it for a required review or another rule on the main branch. It merges once that rule lets it through.
feedBatchBlockedHost: {project}: {label} passed its checks, and the project's host holds it for a required review or another rule on the main branch. It merges once that rule lets it through.
feedBatchFixClosed: {project}: {label} stays held because the repair it waited for closed before its fix was approved. Another repair's fix, or Try again, ends the hold.

feedBatchFormedMany.one: {project}: {count} approved change went up as one batch, {label}.
feedBatchFormedMany.other: {project}: {count} approved changes went up as one batch, {label}.

feedBatchFormedOne: {project}: an approved change went up as {label}.
feedBatchHeldChecks: {project}: {label} is held because {checks} failed. Changes approved meanwhile wait for it.
feedBatchHeldNoWay: {project}: {label} is held because the project allows no merge that keeps one commit for each change.
feedBatchHeldRefused: {project}: {label} is held because the merge was refused where the project lives: {detail}
feedBatchHeldRemoved: {project}: {label} is held because the merge was refused where the project lives: {place} removed the pull request from its merge queue without merging it; its page there says why.
feedBatchHeldRemovedHost: {project}: {label} is held because the merge was refused where the project lives: the project's host removed the pull request from its merge queue without merging it; its page there says why.
feedBatchHeldUnanswered: {project}: {label} is held because {place} did not confirm the merge and the pull request is still open there. Nothing was sent again: Try again sends a new merge.
feedBatchHeldUnansweredHost: {project}: {label} is held because the project's host did not confirm the merge and the pull request is still open there. Nothing was sent again: Try again sends a new merge.
feedBatchHeldUnnamed: {project}: {label} is held because its checks failed. Changes approved meanwhile wait for it.
feedBatchMergeRunning: {project}: {place} took the merge of {label} and still reads it as running, so nothing is sent again and changes approved meanwhile wait. Try again in Settings → Projects closes that pull request and combines the changes on a new one.
feedBatchMergeRunningHost: {project}: the project's host took the merge of {label} and still reads it as running, so nothing is sent again and changes approved meanwhile wait. Try again in Settings → Projects closes that pull request and combines the changes on a new one.

feedBatchMergedMany.one: {project}: {label} merged with {count} change, one commit each.
feedBatchMergedMany.other: {project}: {label} merged with {count} changes, one commit each.

feedBatchNoStory: {project}: {label} is open without the story of {titles}, which could not be added to its description. It is added as soon as it can be.
feedBatchQueued: {project}: {place} took {label} into the main branch's merge queue. It merges there once the queue's checks pass.
feedBatchQueuedHost: {project}: the project's host took {label} into the main branch's merge queue. It merges there once the queue's checks pass.
feedBatchRetried: {project}: {label} was combined again and its checks run again.
feedBatchSentBack: {project}: "{title}" was sent back from its batch: {reason}
feedChecksMergedOutside: The checks merged outside the app
feedChecksNoPull: The checks no pull request yet
feedComputerOtherFirstMate: {name} runs work for another first mate now. Its work on {projects} stops when you remove it {here}.
feedComputerOutOfReach: {name} is out of reach. Its work on {projects} catches up {here} when it is back.
feedContainerFinished: Done: everything under it is finished
feedContainerStopped: Stopped: nothing under it went ahead
feedFirstMateLoginRemoved: You removed {label}, the Claude login your first mate was running on. From its next turn, and after a restart, your first mate runs on another Claude login.
feedFirstMateLoginRemovedNoOther: You removed {label}, the Claude login your first mate was running on. No other Claude login can run your first mate now.
feedMoved: Moved to a stronger model: continues as {key}
feedMovedOnTier: Moved to a stronger model: {tier}; continues as {key}
feedNoChecksEnded: Project {name} · requires pull request checks again: {check} ran on {change}.
feedNoChecksRecorded: Project {name} · runs no pull request checks, as the crewmate of {task} found. Its changes merge without waiting for checks.

feedRepairsCapped.one: {rounds} repairs did not get the checks to pass - your first mate will ask you what to do
feedRepairsCapped.other: {rounds} repairs did not get the checks to pass - your first mate will ask you what to do

feedRepositoryRestarted: Moved to the {repository} repository before its first commit; it starts again there
feedResetRemovalRemoved: {name} was out of reach when Infinitary was reset. It is back, and what Infinitary set up there is removed.
feedResetRemovalStayed: {name} stayed out of reach for 30 days after Infinitary was reset. What Infinitary set up there stays until you delete it there.
feedReviewFindings: The review found things to fix
feedRunProjectHereInstead: To run it {here} instead, set {project} to run on {computer}.
feedRunTaskHereInstead: To run it {here} instead, ask your first mate to run {task} on {computer}.
feedRunsOnAutomatic: Infinitary chooses a computer for each new task in {name}. Started tasks stay where they started.
feedRunsOnFromHere: {name} runs {where} now. Its next task starts there; the one running {here} finishes {here}.
feedRunsOnHere: {name} runs on {computer} now. Its next task starts {here}.
feedRunsOnThere: {name} runs {where} now. Its next task starts there; one already running finishes where it started.

feedTagCheckFinishedMissed.one: {project}: checked one task for tags; {missed} got no answer and stay unchecked.
feedTagCheckFinishedMissed.other: {project}: checked {count} tasks for tags; {missed} got no answer and stay unchecked.

feedUnsafeDataReaderReported: The unsafe data reader reported; its words are on its record.
